Opposition Parties to Meet Over Election Commission Row

Several opposition parties, including the Congress, TMC, CPI(M), CPI, and CPI(ML)-Liberation, are scheduled to meet on September 30 to discuss issues related to the Election Commission. The INDIA bloc is also set to convene on the same date for discussions concerning the Election Commission.
